'''Taisham 11 (January 1)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|979}} - Over a period of time [[Kerene Nagashi]], [[Aisha Raveneos]], [[Valera Gorovni]], [[Ludice Daneen]] and [[Meilyn Arganya]] all leave [[Tar Valon]] to begin their search for the [[Dragon Reborn]].
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Elaida]] orders fifty sisters under [[Toveine Gazal]] to the [[Black Tower]].
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Pedron Niall]] is assassinated by [[Omerna]], who is immediately killed by [[Eamon Valda]]. Valda, supported by [[Rhadam Asunawa]], becomes [[Lord Captain Commander]] of the [[Whitecloaks]].
*{{ne|1000}} - Fire and blood at [[Dumai's Wells]]. The decimated [[Shaido]] retreat to [[Kinslayer's Dagger]]. Most of the [[Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower|Tower Aes Sedai]] are captured. The nine [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Salidar Aes Sedai]] swear fealty to [[Rand]].
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Gawyn]] leads the [[Younglings]] away from Dumai's Wells as [[Galina]] is captured by the [[Shaido]].
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Darlin]] and other [[Tairen]]s join with the rebels outside [[Cairhien]].
